row.evidence: Overflow sells Pro ($19.95 per user/month) and Enterprise (Contact sales, adds Single Sign On (SSO) / SAML); its help centre documents SAML SSO set up by the Overflow team for Enterprise only and no SCIM or provisioning API.
row.notes: Overflow (user-flow diagramming tool by PROTOIO Inc., overflow.io). No SCIM at any tier: the pricing page, Enterprise page and help centre (Zendesk search for scim and provisioning returns nothing) only describe SAML v2 SSO, which is Enterprise-only and configured by Overflow on request. Members are invited and removed by hand on the dashboard People page; removing a member revokes access and their data must be transferred or is deleted. No public API. The pricing card shows $19.95 per user/month (the monthly value; the page offers monthly or annual billing but shows no separate annual price), so the team price is the monthly figure. Status none by absence at medium confidence. New row.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 14-day free trial. Monthly price shown; annual billing exists but no annual price is shown. scim false = not offered at any tier (absence).

scim.notes: Not offered: SSO docs cover SAML v2 only; help-centre search for scim/provisioning returns no articles.

user_api.notes: No public API or developer documentation found; the help centre "api" search returns only a release note.

okta.notes: https://www.okta.com/integrations/overflow/ returns 404. Overflow says SAML works with Okta, OneLogin, Azure, Google and ADFS as custom SAML apps.

entra.notes: No Overflow entry in the Entra SaaS app tutorials index.

fallbacks.notes: Manual invites and removal on the People page (roles Owner, Editor, Contributor). JIT on SAML sign-in is not documented.
